title: SQS Queue Component Configuration
description: Configuration schema for AWS SQS Queue component with compliance hardening and DLQ support

queueName.description: Queue name (optional, will be auto-generated from component name). Required for production environments.

visibilityTimeoutSeconds.description: Visibility timeout in seconds. IMPORTANT: When used as a Lambda event source, this MUST be >= the Lambda function timeout. AWS requirement: queue visibility timeout >= function timeout. Best practice: set to at least 6x the Lambda timeout for retry safety.

receiveMessageWaitTimeSeconds.description: Receive message wait time in seconds (for long polling)

kmsKeyId.description: KMS key ID or ARN for encryption (optional, will be created if needed for high-risk environments)

enableKeyRotation.description: Enable automatic KMS key rotation (recommended for high-risk environments)

maxReceiveCount.description: Maximum number of times a message can be received before moving to DLQ

retentionDays.description: Message retention period for DLQ in days

name.description: Custom dashboard name (optional, auto-generated if not provided)

highRiskEnvironment.description: Enable enhanced security defaults for high-risk environments. When true, automatically enables encryption, dead letter queue, and detailed metrics. Can be set in platform config files or service.yml.

tags.description: Additional resource tags merged with platform standard tags
